stem.text: In the high temperatures of car engines, nitrogen reacts with oxygen to produce nitrogen monoxide.
Which reaction pathway diagram correctly represents this reaction?

A.alt: Energy profile: NO(g) level below the reactants; Ea arrow from reactant level up to the peak; upward DeltaH arrow

B.alt: Energy profile: NO(g) level above the reactants; Ea arrow starts at the NO(g) level and points up to the peak; upward DeltaH arrow from the reactant level

C.alt: Energy profile: NO(g) level above the reactants; Ea arrow points up from the reactant level to the peak; upward DeltaH arrow from reactants to NO(g)

D.alt: Energy profile: NO(g) level above the reactants; Ea arrow points down from the peak to the reactant level; downward DeltaH arrow from NO(g)
